title: API hostname cutover leaves subset of clients on old IP for hours
symptoms: Some regions/users still reach decommissioned servers
Mixed old/new responses from dig @different resolvers
Application errors look like intermittent outages
cause: Previous A/AAAA answers remain cached until TTL expires on recursive resolvers and clients.
solution: Lower TTL well before cutover, perform switch, keep old target healthy for max(old TTL), verify with multiple resolvers.
workaround: Temporarily serve both stacks; use load balancer weighted routing when applicable.
